Therefore the live acceptance check is not satisfied and this cycle is not marked completed.

Do not treat the matching `site/.source-sha`, the successful PR preview, or an HTTP success alone as proof that the canonical public site has updated. If the mismatch persists, diagnose the production hosting/cache path before making unrelated rendered changes.
